ui_findings.evidence: web_jobs.py returns validations sorted by random UUID filename; app.js:644 filters same law_id then takes .at(-1). law_5 shows validation_e5f5f0baa9a2 RMSE 0.0263338575, but chronological last is validation_1f5926c7ef44 RMSE 0.1087107294.
ui_findings.impact: Only while inspecting nonfinal law_5; final submitted law_7 and post-session score remain correct.
ui_findings.suggestion: Resolve the latest successful validate_law event for the selected law_id, or expose explicit chronological order; label the chosen validation id/probe set. Do not mutate archive UUIDs.

ui_findings.evidence: Raw evaluation score explicitly gives 15 (P=0,L=15,C=0), reason=candidate_prediction_invalid. Detail score projection accepts this documented failure score, but baselines.js:49-50 suppresses all scores when evaluation_complete=false.
ui_findings.impact: Same experiment shows 15 in detail/history and a dash in baseline table. These 15 points are recorded declaration points, not provisional or invented scores.
ui_findings.suggestion: Use a shared scoring-state contract. Distinguish evaluation finished with invalid predictions from evaluation pending/interrupted. Show the recorded 15 with a prediction-failure label, or consistently suppress on both pages; do not count either as fully successful rollouts.

ui_findings.evidence: index.html:79 calls Agent validate calls 次独立轨迹验证; app.js:16 labels validate_law 验证独立轨迹; index.html:106 says 验证位置 RMSE and 等待独立轨迹验证. Detailed note only says trajectories did not fit this version.
ui_findings.impact: The probe ids are disjoint from that law training set (checked across all 24 runs), but Agent selected/observed them and may use validation feedback to revise hypotheses. This is not the fixed after-session evaluation or a statistically untouched holdout.
ui_findings.suggestion: Rename to 会话内验证（Agent 自选） and 会话内验证位置 RMSE; explain 未参与当前公式拟合，但 Agent 可查看并据此改进. Label final block 交卷后固定测试（无噪声，24/32 条，本地公开开发集）.

ui_correctness_evidence.candidate_formula_and_fit: app.js:622-645 uses selected law_id to obtain formula, fitted parameters, training RMSE and same-law validation.
ui_correctness_evidence.final_score_subject: app.js:650-651 hides inline submission outcome for another candidate; 681-683 explicitly warns that evaluation is for final submission when another candidate is selected.
ui_correctness_evidence.post_session_label: index.html:116 says 会话后独立测评; baselines.html:10-11 states all fixed 24/32 cases and noiseless truth, local compatibility and not official score.
ui_correctness_evidence.pending_placeholder_logic: app.js:60-68/675 requires evaluation_state=scored and finite stored score; baselines.js:49-50 otherwise displays an em dash. Missing values are not coerced to zero.
ui_correctness_evidence.scope_note: Verified current served JS/HTML source and live HTTP data. No visual screenshot was taken and no evaluation was recomputed.

conclusion: No score/formula mismatch or fabricated placeholder in these 24 runs. 22 have all fixed rollouts successful; 2 have explicit 15-point invalid-prediction outcomes. UI has one stale same-law validation selection and inconsistent handling of scored failures; session validation terminology remains ambiguous.
